title: Posting Groups controlled setup decision after read-only preflight
purpose: Decide the smallest safe setup route for Universaarl posting groups after TARGET-028 proved current page contexts, without writing setup values in this decision case.

learnedPageRoutes.correction: TARGET-028 screenshot QA replaced the old wrong Page 93 assumption.

learnedPageRoutes.page: USt-Buchungsmatrix / VAT Posting Setup read-only boundary

entryCriteria: TARGET-028 observed the required posting-group setup pages read-only in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
No setup value, master data, draft, Preview Posting or Posting was executed by TARGET-028.
Vendor Posting Groups route must use Page 111, not the old Page 93 assumption.
acceptanceCriteria: The decision names which posting-group setup value family is next, or parks it with a clear reason.
The decision does not write any setup values.
The decision keeps VAT matrix correctness, master data, Preview Posting and Posting locked until separate cases unlock them.
The decision includes a lookahead card for the next 3-5 foundation steps.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-028 proved 5/5 posting-group/VAT setup page contexts read-only and corrected Vendor Posting Groups to Page 111. It did not prove setup completeness or account correctness.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: A setup decision is the next safest step before any write because the pages are visible but values and completeness are not yet defined.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Dimensions can resume after posting-group direction and VAT boundary are explicit.
Foundation checkpoint needs posting-group/VAT/dimension status, not just page visibility.
Master data remains locked until posting groups, VAT and dimensions have explicit decisions.
Preview requires master data and posting setup; it is not next.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It converts read-only page context into a bounded setup strategy instead of jumping to master data or repeating VAT matrix writes.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not write posting groups from a decision case.
Do not treat empty setup lists as correct setup.
Do not create customers/vendors/items before posting group values and VAT boundaries are explicit.
requiredPreparation: Read TARGET-028 result and screenshot metadata.
Use SKR04 starter accounts already proven in Universaarl as candidate account references only where appropriate.
Keep VAT Posting Setup matrix parked unless a materially different route is selected.
